qualification.precision: Original-source Q8/group32 FP16 scales; FP16 activations/KV, FP32 GDN state; original small-parameter profile unchanged
qualification.independent_reference_scope: Reuses frozen v100-native-mtp/native-target represented-weight reference gates. This is new exact scalar/batch state and output qualification, not a new BF16/corpus gate.

batch_info.scope: Shared model/workspace counts once; request bytes per slot. Generation counters are shared per most recent cohort, never summed per response. Fixed cohort admission, no MTP/continuous batching/paging.

profile_scope: Separate instrumented CUDA/NVTX runs: scalar has eight native-call ranges, batch one range for eight logical requests. A legacy trace field named requests counts native ranges, not batch logical requests. Kernel duration sums are attribution, not throughput/achieved occupancy.

scalar.scope:
Cohort CUDA timelines joined by each submitting request's NVTX/thread range.

Per-device kernel unions reveal two-GPU overlap, not achieved SM occupancy.

refer only to this process's captured activities, not device-wide idle time.
